subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Power Steering
description: A quick, practical guide to Power Steering.

hook.text: Before power steering, parking a heavy car required serious arm strength and patience.

buildup.text: Hydraulic power steering uses a pump driven by the engine to amplify your steering effort.

discovery.text: Modern electric power steering replaces the pump with a motor, saving fuel and adding flexibility.

twist.text: Electric systems can adjust feel—light for parking, heavy at highway speed—all through software.

climax.text: This same system enables lane-keeping assist. The car can gently steer itself within lane markings.

punchline.text: Power steering went from muscle to motor to mind.

quiz.question: What advantage does electric power steering have over hydraulic?
